sections.title: Problems, input length, and computational models
sections.question: What does a computation solve,and what parameter measures its input size?
sections.worked_case: Uniform reversible parity family on all short binary strings,including empty.
sections.boundary: Pdepthdefinitions/conventions;no complexity separation or physical speedup claim.
sections.code_plan: Actual X/CX calls and probabilities/samples;classical length/generator/resource checks separate.
sections.independent_check: Scalar XOR reference,full-register basis index,all short inputs/two targetbits/two modes.
sections.transfer_task: Fresh padded numeral and untested generator lengths;native n4newstrings with resource/output diagnostics.

sections.title: Reversible computation and uniform circuit families
sections.question: How does an explicit classical uniform circuit family become a clean reversible family?
sections.exit: Gate-list translation,compute invariant,copy/uncompute and polynomial uniformity/cost proof.
sections.worked_case: NAND,half-adder,aliased controls,constants and direct taps with arbitrary output bits.
sections.boundary: Topologically ordered finite Boolean circuit;zero initialized workspace;bounded host/native guards;not a Turing/optimal compiler theorem.
sections.code_plan: Actual X/CX/CCX net and full density/probability/statevector checks;no adjoint API needed.
sections.independent_check: Classical gate evaluator and coherent joint amplitude permutation,not native IR.
sections.transfer_task: Fresh three-input XOR-AND graph,both modes,nonzero outputs and complex joint input.

sections.title: Complexity classes and bounded error
sections.question: What does bounded-error polynomial quantum computation guarantee on every allowed input?
sections.entry: 14.1 uniform input/model definitions;14.2 clean reversible simulation;6.8 fixed-design probability bounds.
sections.exit: Precise P/BPP/BQP contracts,elementary containments,complement closure and fixed-gap normalization proof.
sections.worked_case: Uniform parity with two fair random bits and a reversible error bit;promise selector;independent/shared majority.
sections.boundary: Finite uniform gate alphabet,per-instance promise gap;no unproved separation or finite-test class inference.
sections.independent_check: Scalar fair-coin enumeration,full complex state/density and classical majority histograms.
sections.transfer_task: Fresh length3 noisy-parity strings plus majority-of-three XOR one coin:host graph resource count and smaller explicit native equivalent.

sections.title: Oracle and data-access models
sections.question: What operation is assumed by one oracle query,and which costs and information are outside that assumption?
sections.entry: 14.1input/access models;5.3full Boolean XOR embedding and exact basis/linear action.
sections.exit: Separate classical/value/phase/state access;declare controls/inverses/workspace;distinguish query,payload,logical-gate and preparation costs.
sections.worked_case: Gray table with minterm/structured native realizations,phase-target comparison,dense normalized preparation and d-versus2d counterexample.
sections.boundary: Pdepth access definitions and bounded local derivations;no search/lower-bound/QRAM hardware or free generic loading theorem.
sections.code_plan: Actual native named gates,unitary matrix calls and terminal queries;classical table generation/cost ledger/fingerprint explicit.
sections.independent_check: Inverse-index scalar amplitudes,Walsh sign sum,dense output density and normalized explicit coordinates.
sections.transfer_task: Fresh table and amplitude data,all structured Gray basis pairs,zero oracle and constant phase boundaries.
